US Midterm Elections: Parties Make Final Pitches Amid Voter Concerns

As the US midterm elections approach, political parties are making their final appeals to voters. Concerns about the rising cost of living are a significant issue for voters, with some expressing deep frustration. One report highlights that climate change, while not a top voter priority, could be impacted by the election outcomes. Separately, a Department of Homeland Security official has stated that noncitizens caught illegally voting will be prosecuted and deported.
